Container.Name: channels-dvr
Container.Overview:
Channels DVR Server with proper Unraid permissions, TVE support, and Intel QuickSync.
Based on linuxserver.io Ubuntu Noble base with proper PUID/PGID mapping.
Key Features: - Proper PUID/PGID mapping (no root-owned files) - TV Everywhere (TVE) support - Intel QuickSync hardware transcoding - Auto-updates Channels DVR binary

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Container Path: /channels-dvr - Stores Channels DVR configuration and binary

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Container Path: /shares/DVR - Where recordings are stored

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID - Use 99 for nobody on Unraid

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID - Use 100 for users on Unraid

Config.Name: Update on Start
Config.Description: Check for Channels DVR updates on container start
